description: This is a PHP test class for the CandidateAPI in the Recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It contains unit tests for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidates via API endpoints, using data providers and mock services.

classes.name: CandidateAPITest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for testing CandidateAPI endpoints related to candidate management in the recruitment system, including create, get, update, delete operations.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a candidate via the CandidateAPI using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single candidate by ID via the CandidateAPI.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all candidates via the CandidateAPI.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a candidate via the CandidateAPI.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a candidate via the CandidateAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create candidate test.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for getting a single candidate.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for getting all candidates.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for deleting candidates.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for updating candidates.
